title: New Tardis Mod : ARS Expanded
description: Expands upon the ARS system in the New Tardis Mod
body:
### **For best results, use on a FRESH WORLD or a world where no one has OPENED or GENERATED a TARDIS**

This datapack is made to for the latest version of the New Tardis Mod for 1.20.1 and wont function without it.

This Datapack Currently adds these new areas to Tardis Generation.

* Coral Console Room - 9/10th doctor

* Gallivanter Console Room - Doctor Who Client Mod

* Secondary Control Room - 4th Doctor

* Zero Room

* Barracks
